domains.name: Truck & Haul Planning

domains.name: Milestones & Contract Dates

domains.name: Schedule Update Cycle

domains.name: AI Schedule Intelligence

domains.name: Scheduling Digital Twin

critical_governance: Approved baselines are immutable and revisions require explicit reason and approval.
Schedule calculations are reproducible from logic, calendars, constraints and versioned inputs.
Resource plans integrate workforce, fleet, procurement and subcontractor availability rather than assuming unlimited capacity.
Contract milestones and externally committed dates require controlled change authority.
AI may recommend recovery, constraints and forecasts but may not silently alter approved baselines or contractual commitments.
Delay/impact-analysis records preserve contemporaneous evidence and are separate from legal conclusions.
